above_chance.meaning: the full model beats the shuffled-label baseline on the main target by a margin

beyond_identity.meaning: morphology carries program information beyond the cell-type composition baseline

ci_excludes_zero.meaning: the lower 95 % patient-bootstrap bound of the full model's correlation is above zero

shuffled_at_chance.meaning: the shuffled-label baseline sits at chance, so no leak feeds the model

calibrated.meaning: the 90 % Gaussian interval covers about 90 % of held-out cells (pooled; read the per-patient spread too)

backbone_stable.meaning: the main program has at least three genes that survive stability selection over half-patient refits

inference_parity.meaning: the morphology-only inference path reproduces the training-path predictions on a training slide

stage_association.meaning: the patient-level vector of predicted program burdens is associated with disease stage

external_validation.threshold: validators ran >= 1, every ran validator passed, failed = 0
external_validation.meaning: every validator that could run on the available data met its own stated bar; skipped validators are listed with their reason

decisions: Main target: prog_wnt_camdr_nb_z. Full model per-patient median r = 0.718 (reliability-adjusted 0.723).
ABOVE CHANCE: full (0.718) exceeds the shuffled-label baseline (0.002) by more than 0.05.
MORPHOLOGY BEYOND IDENTITY: full (0.718) exceeds composition_only (-0.035); morphology carries program information beyond cell type. Report as the main finding.
NO IDENTITY BOTTLENECK: oracle (0.760) is not above full (0.718) by 0.05.
SPATIAL PRIOR USEFUL: full (0.718) exceeds no_neighbours (0.620).
Across all targets: 13/16 exceed the shuffled baseline by 0.05.
ABLATION no_program_tokens: full (0.718) vs without (0.710); the program-token cross-attention neither helps nor hurts 0.008 on prog_wnt_camdr_nb_z.
ABLATION no_grid: full (0.718) vs without (0.725); the patch-block tokens neither helps nor hurts 0.007 on prog_wnt_camdr_nb_z.
ABLATION no_smooth: full (0.718) vs without (0.715); the neighbourhood consistency term neither helps nor hurts 0.003 on prog_wnt_camdr_nb_z.
ABLATION align: full (0.718) vs with the contrastive alignment loss switched on (0.689); switching the alignment loss on worsens prog_wnt_camdr_nb_z by 0.029.
LEARNED VS FIXED TARGETS: learned prog_wnt_camdr_nb_z r = 0.718; fixed-set anchor_wnt_camdr_nb_z r = 0.921; learned programs are not more predictable from morphology.
